summary: Stage 6C (Compliance & Housekeeping schedules) verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_stage6c_schedules.py covering /api/schedules/meta (auth-gated, 6 compliance + 6 housekeeping defaults + default_lead_days=14), GET /api/schedules with items+summary (180 baseline items = 15 props × 12), filters (kind=compliance/housekeeping, property_id, status=overdue), POST/PUT (last_done_at recomputes next_due_at = last+cadence; manual next_due_at also works; cadence/label/notes/active/auto_task_lead_days all updatable), DELETE, POST mark-done (last_done_at=today, next_due_at += cadence, linked_task cleared), POST seed-defaults (inserted+skipped sum to 12), auto-task creation on admin/manager GET when next_due past (priority=urgent, title='{label} — {property_name}', category=schedule.kind, due_date=next_due, schedule_item_id linked, linked_task_id round-trip), bump on PUT /api/tasks status=done with schedule_item_id, bump via fallback (category+subtype+property when schedule_item_id is null), DELETE /api/tasks clears linked_task_id, RBAC (manager full CRUD; staff GET filtered to assigned property; staff POST/PUT/DELETE/mark-done all 403; staff GET does NOT trigger auto-task creation). Stage 6B regression suite (16/16) still passes. Frontend Playwright: /compliance loads (admin) with sum-total=180, sum-compliance=90, sum-housekeeping=90, sum-overdue=0, sum-due-soon=0; all 5 filter testids visible; filter-kind=Compliance narrows to 90, filter-clear restores 180, filter-search='Smoke alarm' narrows to 15; mark-done flow confirmed (toast 'Marked done'). Properties editor: edit-{pid} opens editor, prop-toggle-schedule expands the panel (after fix), schedule-panel-{pid} renders with 12 default rows, schedule-add-custom opens schedule-add-editor, adding fire_extinguisher/365 creates a 13th row, schedule-edit-{sid} -> schedule-edit-save-{sid} persists, schedule-mark-done-{sid} bumps, schedule-delete-{sid} removes. Staff RBAC on frontend: nav-compliance hidden for staff, direct /compliance visit allowed and shows only their 12 schedules with ZERO mark-done buttons. No console errors after the import fix.

minor.issue: If only `cadence_days` is updated without re-supplying `last_done_at`, next_due_at is NOT recomputed (only recomputed when last_done_at is present in the payload). May surprise users editing cadence on an already-completed item; recommend recomputing from existing last_done_at when cadence changes.

subtype uniqueness is not enforced per (property_id, kind, subtype) — duplicates are allowed via custom POST, which makes the fallback bump-by-category+subtype hook ambiguous. Consider a unique index or POST-time check.

Auto-sync runs on EVERY admin/manager list call (no cooldown), creating tasks synchronously inside the request. Cheap today (180 items) but will scale linearly with property count; consider a TTL-cached flag or background worker once portfolios grow.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED during this run — `PropertySchedulePanel` was used at line 571 but never imported, causing 'ReferenceError: PropertySchedulePanel is not defined' Uncaught runtime error the instant any property editor expanded the Compliance & Housekeeping schedule section. Added `import PropertySchedulePanel from "@/components/PropertySchedulePanel"`. All per-property panel flows now work.

issues: Mark-done button is shown for admin/manager only; design is fine but the column header still says 'Actions' for staff who see an empty column — consider hiding the column or rendering a status-only column for staff.

critical_code_review_comments: compliance_service.py is well-factored: build_item, status_for_item, needs_task, bump_after_completion, task_priority_for, summarise are pure functions with no DB dependency — easy to unit test. Constants COMPLIANCE_DEFAULTS / HOUSEKEEPING_DEFAULTS / DEFAULT_LEAD_DAYS are explicit and match Stage 6C spec exactly (6 + 6 + 14).

server.py Stage 6C section follows the same RBAC + Pydantic + uuid + ISO-date pattern as Stage 6B tasks — consistent. Auto-task creation correctly resolves assignee: cleaner_user_id for housekeeping, manager_user_id for compliance, falling back to the other role if missing.
_maybe_bump_schedule_for_task correctly handles BOTH explicit schedule_item_id and the (category, subtype, property_id) fallback path — verified end-to-end.
tasks_delete properly clears linked_task_id on the matching schedule_items row using a guarded {id, linked_task_id: tid} filter (avoids clobbering a re-linked task).
GET /api/schedules excludes _id projection consistently. status enrichment is done in Python rather than the DB query, which is fine for ≤5000 items.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stage 6C is solid after the one frontend import fix. Backend regression: `pytest backend/tests/test_stage6c_schedules.py -v` (17 tests, ~7s). The `test_delete_task_clears_linked` test deliberately sets schedule.active=false before deleting the task — otherwise the subsequent GET re-triggers auto-sync and immediately re-links a brand new task. /api/properties returns `{items: [...]}` not a bare list — important for any future test that consumes it.
